PublicRemarks: Get ready to live the golf club life by taking advantage of the newly adjusted price just in time for Spring! 71 Drummers is easy breezy single floor living in a bright and cheery 2 bed 2 full bath unit. New flooring and fresh, neutral paint throughout the entire unit. Hall bath has new tub/shower insert. Primary bath also features updated shower insert.  Ample closet and storage space inside plus a utility closet off the patio. Private and peaceful view from the spacious living room and through the peekaboo window in the kitchen looking out back. Condo fees cover HEAT and WATER plus sewer, gas, trash, landscaping, and  snow removal.  And while pets are not permitted in the association rules, support animals are reviewed on a case by case basis.  Stair free living is possible by using the double  doors to the left of the back entrance. The front of the building is especially charming with a footbridge crossing a small creek, lush trees and a well manicured lawn. Enjoy convenient parking all around the building and extra privacy being tucked in the corner unit. The condo community is located next to the Glenhardie Golf Club which owners may join at a discount. Enjoy golf, swimming, tennis, and the clubhouse for a reasonable cost and no initiation fee for residents. In addition to being in a peaceful setting adjacent to a golf course, Glenhardie offers ultimate convenience of lifestyle. The prime location puts you near all the shopping, dining you could ask for. Easy access to major roads - 76, 276, 476 & 202 - minutes to Life Time Fitness, Valley Forge National Park, Trader Joe's, the King of Prussia Town Center, the King of Prussia Mall, and so much more! Contact agent about pet policy.

Directions: From Old Eagle School Road, Right on Swedesford Road. Left on Drummers Lane.  Upon entering Glenhardie Condos, Turn at second Left, First Building on Right side (Marinus Willet House). Unit is located on top floor (third floor).
